Located in protein-containing complex. Part of Cul2-RING ubiquitin ligase complex and protein serine/threonine phosphatase complex. Expressed in several structures, including germ line. Is an ortholog of human FEM1A (fem-1 homolog A) and FEM1C (fem-1 homolog C).

WB_Overview: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and regulation of RNA splicing. Predicted to be located in nucleus. WB_Overview: Enables RNA polymerase binding activity. Involved in membraneless organelle assembly; regulatory ncRNA-mediated post-transcriptional gene silencing; and siRNA processing. Located in mutator focus and nucleus. Expressed in several structures, including germ cell; germ line; and somatic cell.
MANUAL_DESCRIPTION_WB: mut-16 encodes a glutamine/asparagine (Q/N)-rich domain-containing protein that lacks obvious homologs outside of other nematode species; MUT-16 activity is required for RNA-mediated interference (RNAi), transgene silencing in germ-line and somatic tissues, and for maintaining low levels of transposon mobilization; MUT-16 is thus predicted to play a role in chromatin organizataion and/or regulation of gene expression.

WB_Overview: Involved in several processes, including response to anesthetic; response to ethanol; and response to toluene. Located in axon. WB_Overview: Predicted to enable actin binding activity and phospholipid binding activity. Involved in cell projection assembly and membrane organization. WB_Overview: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in chloride transmembrane transport and sulfate transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Expressed in body wall musculature; excretory cell; hypodermis; intestine; and neurons.
